title: Retry a probed reparse-point open with FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT before recording ProbeFailed (O-028)
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: observed: Failed AnAfUnixSocketFileIsSizedNotReportedAsAFileThatCouldNotBeOpened at ReparseProbeRetryTests.cs:line 56: "the AF_UNIX socket file was flagged ProbeFailed: its metadata open was refused and never retried with FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT"

Derived C1: when the probe's metadata open of a charged reparse-point file fails with ERROR_CANT_ACCESS_FILE (1920), it is retried with FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT before any failure is recorded: missing

Derived C2: an AF_UNIX socket file (non-link, non-cloud reparse tag) in a scanned tree is sized from its own handle, is not flagged ProbeFailed, and does not count toward ScanResult.ProbeFailures: missing
Derived C3: an app-execution alias (IO_REPARSE_TAG_APPEXECLINK) is likewise not recorded as ProbeFailed: missing
Derived C4: such files no longer reach the user-facing note 'N files could not be opened to read their true size on disk': missing

Should files on a cloud sync root whose provider is not running (error 363, tags 0x9000001A and 0x9000701A with no RECALL or OFFLINE bit, about 119 on C:) keep counting toward 'N files could not be opened'? SL-084 leaves them there by scope and does not block on the answer. Changing it needs its own slice that measures what a cldflt-bypassing open reports for such files before any counting changes.

The retry is a new named entry point (OpenReparsePointForAttributes), not a flags parameter on OpenForAttributes. The named method is what makes the flag's single use enforceable by rule A and easy to find with grep.
The regression is duplicated into Core.Tests, not the repro project added to FsAnalyser.slnx. Adding it would be one line, but the tests/bugs projects have been kept out of the solution.
A failed retry reports the retry's error, not the original 1920. This changes only which refusal code appears in a diagnostic, not the count.
The new Facts go in a new file, ReparsePointProbeTests.cs, rather than being added to ProbePassTests.cs.

attempts.head: c3b5eb6853f16912f923a34a95ccf1f1aab0aebe
attempts.summary: The fix itself is sound, and the spikes measured it: retry once on 1920 through SynchronousIoCancel, keep the first open at flags 0, leave 363 alone.
